subject: Staggered settlement slab + credit floor proposal (HealthMetrics pilot)
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@healthmetrics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance.ops@healthmetrics.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T09:14:00Z
Subject: Pilot commercial terms — initial ask (Net45 + €150k cap)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. HealthMetrics is keen to move the pilot into PO stage this month. To align with our internal treasury cadence, we'd like to request Net45 payment terms for the pilot period and a credit cap of €150,000 while we ramp usage.

Two clarifying points from our side:
- VAT handling: we are registered in the Netherlands (VAT ID attached) and will expect standard EU VAT handling; if Redwood requires any withholding or reverse-charge paperwork, send over the forms.
- We can commit to a €40k minimum monthly consumption for the first two months if Redwood can accept Net45 for invoice settlement.

Attached: HM_Pilot_Proposal_Q1.pdf (proposal + forecast).

Please let us know if Redwood can accept Net45 or if you'd prefer a different cadence. We can route a PO once commercial terms are agreed.

Best,
Sara Kemp
Head of Procurement — HealthMetrics
procurement@healthmetrics.com

-----Original Attachment: HM_Pilot_Proposal_Q1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kemp <sara.kemp@healthmetrics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-30T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms — initial ask (Net45 + €150k cap)

Sara —

Thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. Happy to move this forward quickly. A few initial reactions from our side:

1) Net45 for an initial pilot is a bit outside our standard (we typically run Net30 for self-serve / pilot work). Given the requested credit cap (€150k) and the ramp profile, I'm comfortable proposing a staged remit instead:
   - Month 1: Net45 to align with your treasury, with a 10% holdback on each invoice until completion of pilot reconciliation.
   - Month 2 onward: transition to Net30 provided usage and payment cadence are healthy.

2) Credit cap: we can set an initial credit floor of €100,000 (not the full €150k). We will review after 60–90 days and can expand if there are no payment incidents.

3) VAT: we'll need a copy of your VAT registration certificate and a signed EU tax form to apply reverse-charge or other treatments. If you can attach that, we can loop in tax and finalize invoicing treatment.

If that staged remit + €100k initial cap works, I’ll prepare a short payment amendment and SOW for signature (DocuSign). cc'ing Laura for finance approval on the holdback flow.

Next steps: please confirm the minimum monthly commit and attach VAT docs. If you prefer, we can take a 30-minute call this week to finalize.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-31T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms — initial ask (Net45 + €150k cap)

Chloe / Karthik —

I reviewed Sara's proposal and Chloe's staged remit suggestion. A few risk controls from finance/credit side:

- Initial credit cap: I recommend reducing the initial cap to €75,000 operationally, with a pre-agreed review to bump to €100k at day 60 if all invoices are cleared. We don't want to expose ourselves to a single large outstanding balance during onboarding.
- Holdback mechanics: 10% holdback is fine; need explicit language that held amounts are released within 14 days after pilot reconciliation and proof of completion.
- Payment sweep: suggest monthly sweep on the 15th (or next business day) to reduce open AR days.
- Bank references + PO required before we ship any pre-paid credits or allow usage beyond the initial cap.

If HealthMetrics can do a €40k minimum monthly commit and provide VAT registration + bank ref, we can agree to the 60-day review process. If not, we should insist on Net30 out of the gate.

I'll leave negotiation posture to sales. cc'ing Karthik for legal/contract language on the holdback clause.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Sara Kemp <sara.kemp@healthmetrics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance.ops@healthmetrics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-01T11:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms — initial ask (Net45 + €150k cap)

Hi Chloe / Laura,

Thanks for the quick review. HealthMetrics can accept the staged remit approach with a couple of clarifications:

- We can confirm a €40k minimum monthly commit for months 1–2.
- VAT: attaching our certificate (Tax_Cert_HEALTHMETRICS.pdf). We expect Redwood to apply the reverse-charge where applicable; if Redwood needs a signed tax declaration, we can complete it.
- Credit cap: we can accept an initial cap of €100k (we'd prefer not to reduce to €75k). Can Redwood meet us at €100k with a 60-day review?

On bank references: we will supply our standard vendor bank reference and PO within 48 hours after terms confirmation.

Attached: Tax_Cert_HEALTHMETRICS.pdf.

Sara
Head of Procurement — HealthMetrics
procurement@healthmetrics.com

-----Original Attachment: Tax_Cert_HEALTHMETRICS.pdf (PDF, 45KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kemp <sara.kemp@healthmetrics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial terms — initial ask (Net45 + €150k cap)

Sara —

Appreciate the VAT cert and the commit. Based on Laura's controls and your acceptance of staged remit, here's a concise term sheet we can run to DocuSign today:

- Initial credit cap: €100,000 (active immediately).
- Minimum monthly consumption: €40,000 for months 1–2.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices issued on the 1st; payments due Net45 for month 1 invoices, Net30 thereafter.
- Holdback: 10% of each invoice retained until pilot reconciliation; released within 14 days of successful completion and acceptance.
- Payment sweep: automatic sweep on the 15th of the month for any remaining balance.
- VAT: Redwood will apply reverse-charge where valid; HealthMetrics to provide signed tax declaration (we'll attach form to the DocuSign package).

We will prepare three docs: (1) short commercial amendment, (2) SOW (SOW-HealthMetrics-pilot-v2.pdf), (3) DocuSign package (link below). Once signed and we receive bank reference/PO, legal will enable usage beyond the initial cap.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/hm-pilot-sow
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/RDW-7893

If that matches your expectation I will send the package this morning.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW-HealthMetrics-pilot-v2.pdf (DOCX, 72KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-04T16:02:00Z
Subject: Approval to proceed — RDW-7893 (conditional)

Chloe / Laura —

Approved to proceed with the commercial amendment as outlined (initial cap €100k, 10% holdback, staged remit). A couple of final asks from legal/GM:

- Add explicit language that the 60-day review is "subject to timely payment of all invoices and receipt of bank references."
- Approve a one-time 5% early-pay discount if HealthMetrics pays invoices within 10 days of receipt (this is an executive concession to lock the minimum commit).

Chloe: please include both clauses in the DocuSign packet and route to Sara (sara.kemp@healthmetrics.com). Once signed and we receive bank ref + PO, ops can mark the cap live.

Karthik Iyer
VP Legal & Partnerships — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
